h<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" translate="no">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
  
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Ali Sky International | Recruitment & Manpower Support</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Ali Sky International — recruitment, manpower support, visa and travel services.">
  <style>
    :root{
      --navy:#071d36;
      --navy2:#092947;
      --blue:#087fbd;
      --light:#f3f8fc;
      --text:#172333;
      --muted:#697789;
      --line:#e4ebf2;
      --white:#fff;
      --shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(11,36,62,.08);
      --radius:10px;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    body{margin:0;font-family:Inter, "Segoe UI", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;color:var(--text);background:#fff;line-height:1.6;font-weight:500}
    a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
    .container{width:min(1060px,92%);margin:auto}
    header{height:72px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1f5;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20}
    .nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
    .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}
    .logo{width:45px;height:45px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #1388bd;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#0879b4;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;position:relative}
    .logo:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:2px;left:6px;right:6px;height:3px;background:#e72e45;border-radius:5px}
    nav ul{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:25px;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:12px;color:#33404d}
    nav a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
    .hero{min-height:410px;background:
      linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(4,26,49,.94),rgba(6,34,62,.72)),
      url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516321318423-f06f85e504b3?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1800&q=80") center/cover;
      color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center}
    .hero-content{max-width:660px;padding:65px 0}
    .eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700;color:#d9e9f5;margin-bottom:14px}
    .eyebrow:before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:16px;height:2px;background:#e33b50;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:8px}
    h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:42px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.4px;margin:0 0 16px}
    .hero p{max-width:600px;color:#e1ebf4;font-size:14px;margin:0 0 25px}
    .buttons{display:flex;gap:10px}
    .btn{display:inline-block;padding:11px 19px;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid transparent}
    .btn-primary{background:#fff;color:#15314b}.btn-primary:hover{background:#eaf4fb}
    .btn-outline{border-color:#a9bfd1;color:#fff}.btn-outline:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
    section{padding:78px 0;position:relative}#about{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,#f9fcff 100%)}#visa{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,#f7fbfe 100%)}
    .section-title{text-align:center;margin-bottom:34px}
    .section-title h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:27px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.2px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#102943}
    .section-title p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);max-width:650px;margin:auto}
    .soft{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f2f8fd 0%,#eaf3fa 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.soft:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:340px;height:340px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,137,190,.07);top:-160px;right:-80px}.soft:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(8,127,189,.045);bottom:-150px;left:-70px}.soft>.container{position:relative;z-index:1}
    .grid{display:grid;gap:14px}
    .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
    .grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
    .card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border:1px solid #dfe9f1;border-radius:12px;padding:26px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(9,44,76,.09);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 15px 34px rgba(9,44,76,.14)}
    .card .accent{height:2px;width:18px;background:#1a8abb;margin-bottom:14px}
    .card h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.1px;margin:0 0 9px}
    .card p{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#5d6d7e;margin:0}
    .service .accent{background:#1687ba}
    .icon{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:6px;background:#edf7fc;color:#1181b6;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:13px}
    .service h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:800}
    .contact{background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% 15%,rgba(18,127,181,.28),transparent 28%),linear-gradient(135deg,#061b32,#082c4a);color:#fff}
    .contact .section-title h2{color:#fff}
    .contact .section-title p{color:#b9c9d8}
    .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr;gap:42px;align-items:start}
    .contact-info{font-size:11px;color:#cfdae4}
    .contact-info .item{padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
    .contact-info b{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#8fb1c9;margin-bottom:5px}
    .form{background:#fff;color:var(--text);padding:24px;border-radius:10px}
    .form h3{margin:0 0 15px;font-family:Georgia,serif}
    .form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
    label{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
    input,textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid #dce4eb;border-radius:4px;padding:10px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;outline:none}
    textarea{min-height:90px;resize:vertical}
    .field-full{grid-column:1/-1}
    .form .btn{margin-top:10px;background:#087fbd;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}
    .jobs .job{border:1px solid #dce8f0;border-left:4px solid #1687ba;padding:21px 18px;background:#fff;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(10,48,80,.08);transition:transform .2s ease}.jobs .job:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
    .job h3{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 7px}
    .tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
    .tag{background:#edf5fa;color:#31617c;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-size:9px}
    .apply{font-size:10px;color:#087fbd;font-weight:700}
    .cta{text-align:center;margin-top:20px}
    .career-gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px;margin:24px 0 28px}
    .country-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;min-height:190px;background:#102943;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(9,44,76,.12)}
    .country-card img{width:100%;height:190px;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .35s ease}
    .country-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}
    .country-overlay{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;padding:38px 16px 14px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(3,18,34,.9));color:#fff}
    .country-overlay h3{margin:0;font-size:17px}
    .country-overlay p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:10px;opacity:.9}
    .career-apply{background:#fff;border-top:1px solid #dce8f0}
    .career-apply .form{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto}
    .career-apply select{width:100%;border:1px solid #dce4eb;border-radius:4px;padding:10px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;background:#fff}
    .career-apply input[type=file]{padding:8px;background:#fff}
    .career-note{font-size:10px;color:#718293;margin-top:8px}
    .career-photo-note{text-align:center;font-size:9px;color:#7a8b99;margin:0 0 6px}
    @media(max-width:1100px){.career-gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
    @media(max-width:900px){.career-gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
    @media(max-width:520px){.career-gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}.country-card{min-height:170px}.country-card img{height:170px}}
    .contract-section{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7fbfe 0%,#eef6fb 100%);overflow:hidden}
    .contract-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
    .contract-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8f0;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 9px 26px rgba(9,44,76,.08);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
    .contract-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 15px 32px rgba(9,44,76,.13)}
    .contract-card .contract-icon{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;background:#eaf6fc;color:#087fbd;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px}
    .contract-card h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 8px;color:#102943}
    .contract-card p{font-size:11px;color:#657789;margin:0}
    .contract-note{margin:22px auto 0;max-width:760px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#718293}
    @media(max-width:800px){.contract-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
    footer{background:#06172a;color:#aebdca;padding:32px 0;font-size:10px}
    .footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:30px;align-items:center}
    .footer-brand{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
    .footer-brand p{margin:0;max-width:430px}
    .footer-links{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:18px}
    .copyright{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin-top:25px;padding-top:14px;font-size:9px}
    @media(max-width:800px){
      h1{font-size:34px}
      nav ul{gap:12px}
      .grid-3,.grid-2,.contact-grid,.footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .hero{min-height:430px}
      h1{font-size:32px}
      .footer-links{justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
    }
    @media(max-width:560px){
      header{height:auto;padding:12px 0}
      .nav{align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}
      nav ul{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
      nav ul li:nth-child(n+5){display:none}
      section{padding:52px 0}
      .form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .field-full{grid-column:auto}
    }
  button,input,textarea,select{font-family:inherit}h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif} 
    .chairman-section{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f6fbff 0%,#eaf5fc 55%,#f8fcff 100%);overflow:hidden}
    .chairman-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:360px 1fr;gap:55px;align-items:center}
    .chairman-photo{position:relative}
    .chairman-photo:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:22px -18px -18px 18px;background:#0a477c;border-radius:18px;z-index:0;opacity:.95}
    .chairman-photo img{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;height:auto;min-height:300px;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:16px;border:8px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(5,48,83,.18)}
    .chairman-kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#1687c0;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px}
    .chairman-content h2{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;font-size:36px;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 6px;color:#0b2948;font-weight:800}
    .chairman-name{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;color:#087fbd;margin-bottom:6px}
    .chairman-role{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#526b82;margin-bottom:20px}
    .chairman-content p{font-size:13px;color:#526273;max-width:680px}
    .chairman-quote{margin:22px 0;padding:18px 22px;border-left:4px solid #1687c0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;color:#173c5d;font-style:italic;font-size:14px}
    .chairman-points{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:22px}
    .chairman-point{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfebf3;border-radius:9px;padding:15px;box-shadow:0 7px 20px rgba(9,44,76,.06)}
    .chairman-point strong{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#123552;margin-bottom:4px}
    .chairman-point span{font-size:10px;color:#6a7b8c}
    @media(max-width:800px){
      .chairman-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:35px}
      .chairman-photo{max-width:390px;margin:auto}
      .chairman-content h2{font-size:31px}
      .chairman-points{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    }
  
    .team-section{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,#f3f9fd 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .team-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}
    .team-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe9f1;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(9,44,76,.09);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
    .team-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(9,44,76,.15)}
    .team-photo{height:280px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eaf5fc,#d9edf8);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
    .team-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
    .photo-placeholder{width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;background:#cfe8f5;color:#167cad;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:40px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,70,110,.12)}
    .team-info{padding:21px 22px 23px;text-align:center}
    .team-info h3{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#102943;margin:0 0 5px}
    .team-role{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:#087fbd;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:11px}
    .team-info p{font-size:11px;color:#68798a;margin:0}
    .team-note{margin-top:25px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#718293}
    @media(max-width:800px){.team-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.team-photo{height:300px}}
  
    .topbar{background:#061a2e;color:#d9e8f3;font-size:10px;padding:7px 0}
    .topbar-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center}
    .topbar a{color:#fff;font-weight:700}
    .header-main{background:#fff}
    @media(max-width:600px){.topbar-inner{justify-content:center}.topbar-inner span:first-child{display:none}}
    
    /* Overseas country gallery - responsive format */
    .career-gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:30px}
    .country-card{position:relative;min-height:230px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#eaf1f6;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(7,29,54,.12)}
    .country-card img{display:block;width:100%;height:230px;object-fit:cover}
    .country-overlay{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:52px 16px 16px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.78))}
    .country-overlay h3{margin:0 0 3px;font-size:20px;color:#fff}
    .country-overlay p{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:#fff}
    @media(max-width:900px){.career-gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
    @media(max-width:520px){.career-gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}.country-card,.country-card img{height:220px}}

/* Job Circulars */
.circular-section{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7fbff,#eef6fb);padding:70px 0}
.circular-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:28px}
.circular-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dceaf3;border-radius:18px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(11,49,74,.08);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.circular-card:before{content:"JOB CIRCULAR";display:inline-block;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#087fbd;background:#e8f6ff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:30px;margin-bottom:12px}
.circular-card h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:21px}
.circular-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:12px 0 17px}
.circular-meta span{font-size:12px;background:#f1f5f8;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 9px;color:#425866}
.circular-card p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;color:#637582;margin:0 0 18px}
.circular-card .apply{display:inline-block;text-decoration:none}
.circular-note{text-align:center;margin:24px auto 0;max-width:760px;color:#6c7d89;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}
@media(max-width:900px){.circular-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.circular-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.circular-card{padding:20px}}


    .admin-entry{text-align:center;margin-top:24px}
    .admin-toggle,.admin-secondary{border:1px solid #cbd9e4;background:#fff;color:#173c5d;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
    .admin-toggle{background:#102943;color:#fff;border-color:#102943}
    .admin-section{background:#f7fbfe;border-top:1px solid #e2edf4}
    .admin-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8f0;border-radius:14px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(9,44,76,.07);margin-bottom:18px}
    .admin-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;color:#163853}
    .admin-toolbar strong{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:17px}
    .admin-toolbar span{font-size:10px;color:#718293}
    .admin-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px}
    .admin-status{font-size:11px;color:#087fbd;margin:10px 0 0}
    .admin-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
    .admin-row{border:1px solid #e0e9ef;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center}
    .admin-row h4{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:14px;color:#102943}
    .admin-row p{margin:0;color:#687988;font-size:10px}
    .admin-row-actions{display:flex;gap:7px}
    .admin-edit,.admin-delete{border:0;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
    .admin-edit{background:#eaf6fc;color:#087fbd}.admin-delete{background:#fff0f1;color:#c73548}
    .admin-security-note{font-size:10px;color:#718293;text-align:center;max-width:760px;margin:8px auto 0}
    @media(max-width:600px){.admin-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.admin-row-actions{justify-content:flex-start}.admin-toolbar{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="topbar"><div class="container topbar-inner"><span>International Recruitment &amp; Manpower Support</span><span>WhatsApp: <a href="tel:+8801762731887">+880 1762731887</a></span></div></div>
<div class="topbar"><div class="container topbar-inner"><span>International Recruitment &amp; Manpower Support</span><span>Email: <a href="email:aliskyinternational87@gmail.com">aliskyinternational87@gmail.com</a></span></div></div>

<header>
  <div class="container nav">
    <a class="brand" href="#"><span class="logo">ASI</span><span>Ali Sky International</span></a>
    <nav>
      <ul>
        <li><a href="#home">Home</a></li>
        <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
        <li><a href="#chairman">Chairman</a></li>
        <li><a href="#management">Management</a></li>
        <li><a href="#services">Services</a></li>
        <li><a href="#visa">Visa Services</a></li>
        <li><a href="#jobs">Jobs</a></li>
        <li><a href="#careers">Careers</a></li><li><a href="#circulars">Job Circulars</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contract">Contract</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="hero-content">
      <div class="eyebrow">RECRUITMENT &amp; MANPOWER SUPPORT</div>
      <h1>Connecting People With Global Opportunities.</h1>
      <p>Ali Sky International provides recruitment, manpower and career support for international opportunities.</p>
      <div class="buttons">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#jobs">View Jobs</a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline" href="#contact">Contact Us</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="about">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-title">
      <h2>About Ali Sky International</h2>
      <p>We support candidates and recruitment partners with professional communication, manpower coordination and application guidance.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="grid grid-3">
      <div class="card"><div class="accent"></div><h3>Our Mission</h3><p>To connect suitable candidates with genuine international opportunities.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="accent"></div><h3>Our Vision</h3><p>To become a trusted recruitment and manpower support brand from Bangladesh.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="accent"></div><h3>Our Values</h3><p>Professionalism, responsibility, transparency and clear communication.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>


<section class="chairman-section" id="chairman">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="chairman-wrap">
      <div class="chairman-photo">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
             alt="Sheikh Forahad Hossain Ali, Chairman of Ali Sky International">
      </div>
      <div class="chairman-content">
        <div class="chairman-kicker">OUR LEADERSHIP</div>
        <h2>Chairman</h2>
        <div class="chairman-name">Sheikh Forahad Hossain Ali</div>
        <div class="chairman-role">Chairman, Ali Sky International</div>
        <p>Sheikh Forahad Hossain Ali leads Ali Sky International with a clear vision to connect talented people with international opportunities and to build trusted recruitment and manpower support services.</p>
        <div class="chairman-quote">“Our mission is to connect talented people with global opportunities and build a better future together.”</div>
        <div class="chairman-points">
          <div class="chairman-point"><strong>Visionary Leadership</strong><span>Guiding the company toward a global future.</span></div>
          <div class="chairman-point"><strong>Trusted Partnership</strong><span>Building professional, long-term relationships.</span></div>
          <div class="chairman-point"><strong>Global Opportunities</strong><span>Creating pathways for skilled professionals.</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>


<section class="team-section" id="management">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-title">

<script>
(function(){
  const form = document.getElementById('careerApplyForm');
  if (!form) return;
  const status = document.getElementById('careerFormStatus');
  const button = document.getElementById('careerApplyBtn');
  const position = document.getElementById('careerPosition');
  const whatsappNumber = '8801762731887';

  document.querySelectorAll('.apply[data-job]').forEach(function(link){
    link.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (position) { position.value = this.getAttribute('data-job') || ''; }
      const countrySelect = form.querySelector('[name="country"]');
      if (countrySelect) {
        const country = this.getAttribute('data-country') || '';
        if (country) countrySelect.value = country;
      }
    });
  });

  form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const honey = form.querySelector('[name="_honey"]');
    if (honey && honey.value) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Submitting...';
    status.textContent = 'Sending your job application to email and preparing WhatsApp...';

    const data = new FormData(form);
    const email = data.get('email') || '';
    data.set('_replyto', email);
    const name = data.get('name') || '';
    const phone = data.get('phone') || '';
    const country = data.get('country') || '';
    const job = data.get('position') || '';
    const experience = data.get('experience') || '';
    const message = data.get('message') || '';
    const cv = data.get('cv');
    const cvName = cv && cv.name ? cv.name : 'Not attached';
    const whatsappText = [
      'New Job Application - Ali Sky International',
      '',
      'Name: ' + name,
      'Email: ' + email,
      'Phone / WhatsApp: ' + phone,
      'Preferred Country: ' + country,
      'Position: ' + job,
      'Experience: ' + experience,
      'CV: ' + cvName,
      'Message: ' + message
    ].join('\n');
    const whatsappUrl = 'https://wa.me/' + whatsappNumber + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent(whatsappText);
    const whatsappWindow = window.open(whatsappUrl, '_blank');

    try {
      const response = await fetch(form.action, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
        body: data
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Email service error');
      status.textContent = 'Application submitted successfully! Email sent to Ali Sky International and WhatsApp opened with the same details.';
      form.reset();
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = 'WhatsApp has been opened. Email sending could not be confirmed; please try again if needed.';
      if (whatsappWindow) whatsappWindow.focus();
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Submit Job Application';
    }
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  const form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
  if (!form) return;
  const status = document.getElementById('formStatus');
  const button = document.getElementById('sendMessageBtn');
  const whatsappNumber = '8801762731887';

  form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const honey = form.querySelector('[name="_honey"]');
    if (honey && honey.value) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Sending...';
    status.textContent = 'Sending your enquiry to email and preparing WhatsApp...';

    const data = new FormData(form);
    const email = data.get('email') || '';
    data.set('_replyto', email);

    const name = data.get('name') || '';
    const phone = data.get('phone') || '';
    const subject = data.get('subject') || 'Website Enquiry';
    const message = data.get('message') || '';
    const whatsappText = [
      'New Website Enquiry - Ali Sky International',
      '',
      'Name: ' + name,
      'Email: ' + email,
      'Phone: ' + phone,
      'Subject: ' + subject,
      'Message: ' + message
    ].join('\n');
    const whatsappUrl = 'https://wa.me/' + whatsappNumber + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent(whatsappText);

    // Open WhatsApp immediately so popup blockers do not stop it.
    const whatsappWindow = window.open(whatsappUrl, '_blank');

    try {
      const payload = Object.fromEntries(data.entries());
      const response = await fetch(form.action, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        let detail = '';
        try { detail = await response.text(); } catch (_) {}
        throw new Error('Email service error' + (detail ? ': ' + detail : ''));
      }
      status.textContent = 'Sent successfully! Your enquiry was emailed and WhatsApp has been opened with the same details.';
      form.reset();
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = 'WhatsApp has been opened. Email sending could not be confirmed; please try again if needed.';
      if (whatsappWindow) whatsappWindow.focus();
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Send Message';
    }
  });
})();
</script>

    {id:'8',title:'Hospitality / Service Staff',country:'Philippines',type:'Full Time',tag:'Service',description:'Service and hospitality opportunities subject to current vacancy and employer requirements.'}
  ];
  const flagMap={Malaysia:'🇲🇾',Maldives:'🇲🇻','Saudi Arabia':'🇸🇦',China:'🇨🇳','South Korea':'🇰🇷',Thailand:'🇹🇭',Philippines:'🇵🇭',Other:'🌍'};
  const grid=document.getElementById('publicCircularGrid');
  const adminPanel=document.getElementById('adminPanel');
  const openBtn=document.getElementById('openAdminBtn');
  const logoutBtn=document.getElementById('adminLogoutBtn');
  const form=document.getElementById('jobCircularForm');
  const list=document.getElementById('adminCircularList');
  const count=document.getElementById('adminCount');
  const status=document.getElementById('adminStatus');
  const idInput=document.getElementById('circularId');
  const titleInput=document.getElementById('adminTitle');
  const countryInput=document.getElementById('adminCountry');
  const typeInput=document.getElementById('adminType');
  const tagInput=document.getElementById('adminTag');
  const descInput=document.getElementById('adminDescription');
  const saveBtn=document.getElementById('saveCircularBtn');
  const cancelBtn=document.getElementById('cancelEditBtn');
  const modeTitle=document.getElementById('adminModeTitle');
  const positionSelect=document.getElementById('careerPosition');
  function getCirculars(){
    try{ const raw=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); if(raw) return JSON.parse(raw); }catch(e){}
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(defaultCirculars));
    return defaultCirculars.slice();
  }
  function saveCirculars(items){ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(items)); renderPublic(); renderAdmin(); }
  function escapeHtml(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>'"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','\'':'&#39;','"':'&quot;'}[c]})}
  function renderPublic(){
    const items=getCirculars();
    if(!items.length){grid.innerHTML='<div class="card" style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center"><h3>No job circulars available</h3><p>Please check again later.</p></div>';return;}
    grid.innerHTML=items.map(x=>`<article class="circular-card"><h3>${escapeHtml(x.title)}</h3><div class="circular-meta"><span>${flagMap[x.country]||'🌍'} ${escapeHtml(x.country)}</span><span>${escapeHtml(x.type||'Employment')}</span>${x.tag?`<span>${escapeHtml(x.tag)}</span>`:''}</div><p>${escapeHtml(x.description)}</p><a class="apply" href="#career-apply" data-job="${escapeHtml(x.title)}" data-country="${escapeHtml(x.country)}">Apply Now →</a></article>`).join('');
    bindApplyLinks();
    syncPositionOptions(items);
  }
  function syncPositionOptions(items){
    if(!positionSelect)return;
    const existing=new Set(Array.from(positionSelect.options).map(o=>o.value));
    items.forEach(x=>{if(!existing.has(x.title)){const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=x.title;o.textContent=x.title;positionSelect.appendChild(o);}});
  }
  function bindApplyLinks(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.apply[data-job]').forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click',function(){
      const formEl=document.getElementById('careerApplyForm'); if(!formEl)return;
      const pos=document.getElementById('careerPosition'); const country=formEl.querySelector('[name="country"]');
      const job=this.dataset.job||''; if(pos){let opt=Array.from(pos.options).find(o=>o.value===job);if(!opt){opt=document.createElement('option');opt.value=job;opt.textContent=job;pos.appendChild(opt);}pos.value=job;}
      if(country && this.dataset.country) country.value=this.dataset.country;
    }));
  }
  function renderAdmin(){
    const items=getCirculars(); count.textContent=items.length+' circular'+(items.length===1?'':'s');
    list.innerHTML=items.length?items.map(x=>`<div class="admin-row"><div><h4>${escapeHtml(x.title)}</h4><p>${flagMap[x.country]||'🌍'} ${escapeHtml(x.country)} · ${escapeHtml(x.type||'Employment')}${x.tag?' · '+escapeHtml(x.tag):''}</p></div><div class="admin-row-actions"><button class="admin-edit" type="button" data-edit="${x.id}">Edit</button><button class="admin-delete" type="button" data-delete="${x.id}">Delete</button></div></div>`).join(''):'<p style="font-size:11px;color:#718293">No circulars yet. Add your first job circular above.</p>';
    list.querySelectorAll('[data-edit]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>startEdit(b.dataset.edit));
    list.querySelectorAll('[data-delete]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>deleteCircular(b.dataset.delete));
  }
  function resetForm(){form.reset();idInput.value='';modeTitle.textContent='Add New Job Circular';saveBtn.textContent='Add Circular';cancelBtn.hidden=true;status.textContent='';}
  function startEdit(id){
    const x=getCirculars().find(v=>v.id===id);if(!x)return;
    idInput.value=x.id;titleInput.value=x.title;countryInput.value=x.country;typeInput.value=x.type||'';tagInput.value=x.tag||'';descInput.value=x.description||'';
    modeTitle.textContent='Edit Job Circular';saveBtn.textContent='Update Circular';cancelBtn.hidden=false;adminPanel.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
  }
  function deleteCircular(id){
    const x=getCirculars().find(v=>v.id===id);if(!x)return;
    if(!confirm('Delete this job circular?\n\n'+x.title))return;
    saveCirculars(getCirculars().filter(v=>v.id!==id)); status.textContent='Circular deleted successfully.';
  }
  openBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    const saved=localStorage.getItem(PASSWORD_KEY);
    const entered=prompt('Ali Sky Admin Password:');
    if(entered===null)return;
    if(entered!==(saved||DEFAULT_PASSWORD)){alert('Incorrect admin password.');return;}
    adminPanel.hidden=false; adminPanel.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); renderAdmin();
  });
  logoutBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{adminPanel.hidden=true;window.scrollTo({top:document.getElementById('circulars').offsetTop,behavior:'smooth'});});
  cancelBtn.addEventListener('click',resetForm);
  form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const item={id:idInput.value||Date.now().toString(),title:titleInput.value.trim(),country:countryInput.value,type:typeInput.value.trim()||'Employment',tag:tagInput.value.trim(),description:descInput.value.trim()};
    if(!item.title||!item.country||!item.description){status.textContent='Please fill in all required fields.';return;}
    const items=getCirculars(); const idx=items.findIndex(v=>v.id===item.id);
    if(idx>=0){items[idx]=item;status.textContent='Circular updated successfully.';}else{items.unshift(item);status.textContent='New circular added successfully.';}
    saveCirculars(items);resetForm();status.textContent=idx>=0?'Circular updated successfully.':'New circular added successfully.';
  });
  renderPublic();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
